campaign: Deterministic RSI storage and execution control plane
doctrine: OvergoDB remains the sole canonical artifact transaction authority. Modularization separates a small hash-chained metadata journal, immutable content-addressed blobs, compiled Go projections and checkpoints, and bounded operational coordination while preserving artifact.Repository, global ordering, atomic batches, alias compare-and-set, lineage validation, read-only refresh, backup, retention, and deterministic replay. High-volume observations are chunked into blobs and committed through bounded summaries; heartbeats, wake signals, and partial process output remain operational unless they cause a meaningful durable transition. Multica and semantic-router are used only as independently re-expressed inventories of operational problems and observable behavior: no source, schema, file format, runtime, Markdown skill, plugin mechanism, or product layer is copied. RSI additions use typed versioned Go records, existing Overgo owners, derived distribution-free decisions, explicit missing-data coverage, and architecture tests that refuse bypasses. Interaction efficiency is an external behavior: equal or better task capability with fewer semantic commits, projection scans, bytes, wakeups, context repetitions, model turns, tool calls, retries, and waits. Every optimization starts from a measured representative interaction trace, preserves exact admitted inputs and evidence, consolidates common policy or mechanics, and deletes the displaced path in the same commit.

items.title: Add governed webhook ingress to the existing automation runtime

steps.title: Dispatch accepted deliveries through AutomationRuntime with exact recovery and one workflow operation
steps.rationale: Signature validation, deduplication, admission, operation creation, and recovery form one deterministic lifecycle. Retries recover the recorded plan rather than executing a newly resolved recipe or emitting duplicate outbound effects.

items.title: Make resource fitness and evidence coverage first-class RSI inputs

steps.title: Unify tokens, cache use, wall and active compute, CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, interaction counts, retries, and integer cost units
steps.rationale: Training, evaluation, serving, agents, tools, workflows, peers, and UI operations must report comparable resource and interaction facts without collapsing model, hardware, provider, workload, or attempt identity. Semantic commits, scans, bytes, wakeups, context repetition, model turns, tool calls, retries, and waits are counted by existing owners; unknown measurements remain unknown rather than zero.

steps.title: Chunk high-volume serving and execution samples into bounded canonical blobs with small summary commits
steps.rationale: Per-token, per-message, and hardware samples must not flood the journal. Canonical encoding, count and byte bounds, source identities, and summary digest make each chunk reproducible and independently verifiable.

steps.title: Project measurement, evaluation, hardware, causal, failure-classification, and pairing coverage separately from scores
steps.rationale: Missing evidence is not favorable evidence. Every aggregate reports observed, missing, degraded, unclassified, uncosted, recovered, and paired counts, anchored to an exact journal head and projection version.

steps.title: Require improvement comparisons to evaluate capability, quality, resource, and coverage deltas together
steps.rationale: A candidate cannot improve by moving failures, latency, memory, retries, or unmeasured work into another subsystem. Promotion comparisons cite source chunks and materialize the exact aggregate contract used.

items.title: Reduce component, agent, tool, peer, and operator interactions without losing admitted work or evidence

steps.title: Route bounded queries through exact compiled indexes and report inspected, matched, returned, and loaded facts
steps.rationale: Kind, media, schema, sequence, alias, lineage, contract, and causal lookups use their owning projection rather than scanning the complete catalog. The planner is deterministic for a query contract and head; a missing index may refuse an unbounded request rather than silently perform a full scan.

steps.title: Serve initial snapshots plus ordered head-bound deltas to read-only peers, runtime views, and the embedded UI
steps.rationale: Consumers stop reloading complete state or polling parallel authorities. A delta is derived from canonical commits, names previous and resulting heads, coalesces only commutative view changes, and forces a bounded snapshot resync when continuity or projection version differs.

steps.title: Reuse content identities and admitted stimulus cursors so resumable sessions receive only new interaction arcs
steps.rationale: Repeated source content is referenced once and later occurrences preserve provenance without duplicating bytes. A runtime capability that proves session continuity may receive only the stable cursor delta; stateless or retired sessions deterministically rebuild the bounded full context. Optimization cannot omit an admitted stimulus.

steps.title: Coalesce wakeups, claims, capability refreshes, and reconciliation work around semantic dirty-state boundaries
steps.rationale: Reconnect flaps, repeated wake signals, duplicate deliveries, and unchanged capability probes produce one pending reconciliation rather than one run each. Claims and reads are batched within existing authority boundaries; every admitted item is processed once or remains visibly pending.

steps.title: Project one causal operation timeline and one pending-decision view for approvals, refusals, retries, quarantine, and rollback
steps.rationale: The operator should not reconstruct state across logs, dashboards, recipes, and peer pages. The view cites canonical evidence and exposes idempotent typed actions; it creates no new decision authority and does not duplicate domain state.

steps.title: Reject interaction optimizations that lose capability, evidence, determinism, or merely shift work to another component
steps.rationale: Candidate and baseline traces must complete the same task contract with equivalent admitted inputs and evidence. A win requires a Pareto improvement or an explicit tradeoff decision across semantic commits, scans, bytes, wakeups, repeated context, model turns, tool calls, retries, waits, wall time, and resource peaks; missing counters block the claim.

items.title: Represent model prototypes as typed hypotheses that compile through registered Go capabilities

steps.title: Define an immutable model prototype binding parent, architecture profile, derivation policy, training objective, dataset splits, capability hypothesis, budgets, and code evidence
steps.rationale: A prototype is a content-addressed hypothesis, not executable code, weights, or an active recipe. Its architecture name must resolve to a compiled Go registration; all policy and evidence dependencies are exact artifact IDs; code identity is evidence and cannot authorize execution.

steps.title: Extend improvement proposals and controller actions to admit model-prototype candidates with causal, authority, budget, development-split, and falsifier closure
steps.rationale: The controller may propose a prototype but cannot construct or train it until admission binds the motivating evidence, incumbent, independent promotion split, resource ceiling, registered Go implementation, and objective that can reject the hypothesis.

steps.title: Compile an admitted prototype into scratch construction, training program, evaluation plan, and candidate task recipes without source generation
steps.rationale: Compilation reuses scratchmodel derivation, registered model architecture, modelrecipe catalogs, trainingprogram, and evaluation owners. It derives tensor shapes, initialization, optimizer/session/resource plans, and recipe dependencies; an unsupported operator or capability refuses before compute.

steps.title: Atomically publish trained model, tensor inventory, resolved model definition, trial receipts, and candidate recipes from a successful prototype trial
steps.rationale: A prototype never becomes a model by alias mutation alone. Successful construction and training produce immutable weights and tensor inventory; ModelDefinitionDocument binds those bytes to the exact profile and architecture; candidate recipes cite the resolved definition and trial evidence in one atomic artifact batch.

items.title: Derive, validate, evaluate, and activate task recipes for prototype-produced models

steps.title: Derive inference, training, evaluation, composition, and agent-facing recipe candidates from resolved model definitions and compiled module catalogs
steps.rationale: Recipes remain immutable recipe.Definition artifacts: closed-world node and edge graphs whose modules are compiled Go capabilities. They bind model definition, profile, processor, placement, residency, session, evaluation, and policy artifacts without embedding code or discovering filesystem instructions.

steps.title: Compile each candidate recipe against exact model, peer, tool, and runtime capabilities and publish verification evidence
steps.rationale: A recipe candidate is not runnable because it parses. Validation proves every module, port, dependency, placement, residency, session policy, tool grant, and resource requirement against exact capability identities and records refusal rather than selecting a fallback topology.

steps.title: Evaluate prototype-produced recipes on development and promotion evidence while separating model, recipe, and system deltas
steps.rationale: The RSI loop must identify whether a gain came from weights, architecture, derivation policy, recipe graph, placement, or another system change. Comparisons bind the same model and split where recipe behavior is the candidate variable and report capability, quality, resources, and coverage.

steps.title: Drive candidate, validated, active, refused, superseded, retired, and rollback transitions through the existing modelrecipe lifecycle
steps.rationale: Activation remains evidence-gated and atomic. Active aliases are scoped by model and task, compare-and-set against the incumbent, cite verification and evaluation evidence, and never make the prototype document itself executable. Supersession and refusal preserve both candidates and their causal evidence.

items.title: Route task execution to models through typed evidence-derived decisions

steps.title: Define a typed routing decision record binding task signal, candidate set, evidence basis, and derived selection
steps.rationale: A routing decision is a canonical fact: which verified model or recipe serves a task, derived from published evaluation and resource evidence with distribution-free bounds and no tunable weights. The record names the candidates considered, the evidence each was judged on, and the derivation, so selection is replayable and auditable like any other promotion.

steps.title: Derive model selection from published evaluation and resource evidence and record every decision
steps.rationale: Selection prefers the cheapest verified candidate whose published evidence meets the task threshold; evidence admission follows one ordered gate owner. Every live selection commits its decision record through the common publication path, turning the benchmark substrate from passive record into an active control input.

steps.title: Replay recorded routing decisions under a candidate policy and publish measured counterfactual deltas
steps.rationale: A candidate selection policy is evaluated against the recorded decision corpus before any live rollout: identical inputs, both policies, published deltas with coverage. Counterfactual evidence is a required admission input for routing-policy rollout plans, so policy improvement is measured at near-zero cost before it is trusted with live work.

items.title: Validate promoted candidates through immutable deterministic rollout plans

steps.title: Define a content-addressed rollout plan binding baseline, candidate, cohort key, hash version, observation contract, and rollback authority
steps.rationale: A rollout is evidence-bearing promotion policy, not a mutable feature flag. Cohort size, observation requirements, and boundaries are derived from evaluation evidence or explicit typed decisions with reopen triggers.

steps.title: Assign workloads deterministically and keep the same arm across retry, replay, peer placement, and restart
steps.rationale: Assignment uses a canonical key separator and pinned hash version with golden vectors. Every observation records plan and arm; disabled or ineligible workloads can never leak into the candidate arm.

steps.title: Materialize rollout reports with head, projector version, query contract, source chunk IDs, coverage, and result digest
steps.rationale: Promotion and rollback consume immutable reports, never a dashboard value or mutable projection row. Rebuilding the same projector at the same head reproduces the digest; a new projector version produces new evidence.

steps.title: Require improvement promotion to bind rollout plan, baseline evidence, candidate evidence, coverage, and rollback contract
steps.rationale: Offline evaluation may admit a candidate to rollout but does not universally activate it. Compare-and-set activation changes only through the promotion owner after the required evidence closure is present.

items.title: Quarantine or roll back candidates from distribution-free live evidence

steps.title: Derive live comparison windows and alarm boundaries from each metric history with explicit coverage requirements
steps.rationale: No Gaussian, stationary, or IID assumption is introduced. Small samples refuse decisions unless envelopes separate; larger histories use the repository doctrine's distribution-free summaries and record the derivation evidence.

steps.title: Publish advisory, finding, quarantine, and operator-stop transitions from sustained correctness, failure, cost, latency, or coverage regressions
steps.rationale: The circuit breaker requires enough comparable observations and excludes skipped or inapplicable work from success and failure ratios. A single noisy window can advise; escalation follows the recorded confirmation policy.

steps.title: Rollback the active alias with compare-and-set and publish the exact regression evidence and causal link
steps.rationale: Only the promotion authority can change the active binding. Concurrent promotion, rollback, or operator action has one winner; stale decisions refuse and preserve their evidence without overwriting a newer head.

steps.title: Require new evidence and explicit authority before a quarantined candidate or mechanism family re-enters rollout
steps.rationale: Restart, replay, or another controller proposal cannot clear quarantine. Reentry names the prior finding, changed mechanism, new evaluation, decider, and fresh rollout plan.

items.title: Enforce the Go-only RSI architecture and prove the storage transition end to end

steps.title: Refuse production bypasses around process, model, tool, network, trigger, commit, and promotion authorities
steps.rationale: Self-modifying code must not create a second side-effect path. Architecture tests inspect production imports and constructors, permit narrow test exceptions, and require each new trigger to declare causal, authority, budget, idempotency, and evidence behavior.

steps.title: Refuse Markdown-discovered behavior, interpreted plugins, runtime scripts, and non-Go extension authority
steps.rationale: Prompts and descriptions may remain typed artifact data, but files named as skills, plugin manifests, embedded interpreters, or filesystem discovery cannot grant capabilities or alter runtime semantics.

steps.title: Rebuild a legacy store into segmented journal, blob, and projection layout and execute backup, restore, retention, and rollback drills
steps.rationale: The drill uses the pinned compatibility and scale corpus, compares query and content digests, injects interruption at each publication boundary, opens the destination read-only, and proves the source remains untouched and recoverable.

steps.title: Run one prototype through model and recipe materialization, execution, evaluation, rollout, live regression, atomic rollback, and reproducible explanation
steps.rationale: Acceptance requires externally visible control behavior, not only new record types: admitted prototype, compiled Go construction, resolved model definition, validated task recipe, exact capability placement, bounded stimuli, terminal attempt evidence, resource and coverage comparison, measured interaction reduction without lost work, deterministic cohorting, live containment, and causal evidence reproduced after cold rebuild.

steps.title: Re-run common-code and policy-copy census and record the campaign tightening delta
steps.rationale: The campaign closes only if shared components replaced duplicate process, publication, failure, retry, capability, trigger, resource, query, reconciliation, and storage mechanics rather than adding parallel frameworks. The measured census and interaction-trace delta live in OvergoDB and the plan retains no completion ledger.
